explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and at D2 it is above 0 only when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by a common transition (choosing a2, or any rare transition, gives 0). That D2 value grows with a streak of recent rewarded common a1-to-S1 trials and with time in the episode: about 3-7 before trial 80 and 9-10 late in the episode after several rewarded trials in a row, while it drops to 4-5 if the previous trial went unrewarded and to 0-3 right after a rare transition or two unrewarded trials.
